programme.sub-title: Florida Panthers at Toronto Maple Leafs
programme.desc: The Panthers visit the Maple Leafs for Game 1 of an East semifinal. Florida ousted Toronto 4-1 in the 2023 second round. William Nylander (TOR) recorded nine points in the first-round win over Ottawa. Florida bumped rival Tampa Bay in five games.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.sub-title: Florida Panthers at Toronto Maple Leafs
programme.desc: The Panthers and Maple Leafs play Game 2 of an East semifinal. Toronto survived Florida's late Game 1 surge to win 5-4. Joseph Woll (TOR) made 17 stops in relief of Anthony Stolarz, who left the game after taking a Sam Bennett elbow to the head.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.sub-title: Toronto Maple Leafs at Florida Panthers
programme.desc: The Maple Leafs, owners of a 2-0 lead, visit the Panthers for Game 3 of an East semifinal. Toronto protected home ice by repelling Florida 4-3 in Game 2 behind Joseph Woll's 25 saves. Teams leading 2-0 have won 86% of Stanley Cup playoff series.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.sub-title: Toronto Maple Leafs at Florida Panthers
programme.desc: The Panthers try to tie up their East semifinal against the Maple Leafs, down 2-1 entering Game 4. Facing a potential 3-0 deficit in overtime, former Boston captain Brad Marchand tormented Toronto again, scoring the winning goal in Florida's 5-4 win.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.sub-title: Florida Panthers at Toronto Maple Leafs
programme.desc: The Maple Leafs host the Panthers for Game 5 of their Eastern Conference semifinal. Sergei Bobrovsky recorded his second shutout of the postseason to help Florida even the series with a 2-0 Game 4 win. Joseph Woll (TOR) stopped 35 shots in the loss.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.sub-title: Toronto Maple Leafs at Florida Panthers
programme.desc: The Panthers try to put away the Maple Leafs in Game 6 of their East semifinal. Florida took a 3-2 series lead with a 6-1 victory. Sergei Bobrovsky (FLA) was denied a second consecutive shutout when Toronto scored with 1:06 remaining in Game 5.

programme.title: NHL Hockey
programme.sub-title: Florida Panthers at Toronto Maple Leafs
programme.desc: The Maple Leafs try to slay their ghosts in Game 7 of the East semifinal with the Panthers. Toronto stayed alive with a resolute 2-0 Game 6 victory in Florida. Auston Matthews (TOR) broke a 0-0 tie with a third-period goal, his first of the series.

They also learn their identity is about what you love to do. So, they add onto their self-portraits and then share their drawings with each other. Elmo draws his red fur, orange nose, a piano, and watering a flower with Abby because being a kind neighbor is part of Elmo’s identity. programme.title: Bakit Lahat ng Gwapo May Boyfriend?
programme.desc: Kylie (Anne Curtis), a wedding planner has had a long string of boyfriends. Unfortunately for her, they've all been gay.

programme.title: Anong Ganap?
programme.desc: Being in on the entertainment circle is quick and easy on PBO's Anong Ganap? Presented by the gorgeous entertainment anchor ng bayan, Phoemela Baranda.

programme.title: Revirginized
programme.desc: Carmela (Sharon Cuneta) gets to enjoy life again in a wild beach party. With young people and a hunk tattoo artist, she drowns herself in alcohol to forget her current self and renew her old self.

programme.title: Pilak
programme.desc: Pilak.

programme.title: Ikaw Pa Rin Ang Pipiliin Ko
programme.desc: Music gives her life. Music is his life. This is a story that will make our hearts skip a beat this season of love.

programme.title: Hating Kapatid
programme.desc: Hating Kapatid is a movie that teaches us how siblings should stick together in times of happiness and problems.

programme.title: Diary ng Panget
programme.desc: Eya (Nadine Lustre) and Cross (James Reid) didn't get along at first, their relationship becomes complicated but soon, they fall in love with each other.

programme.title: Wangbu
programme.desc: Dodong (Jay Manalo) moves his family to Manila in search for a better life. But his dream for a brighter future starts crumbling when he catches his son sniffing solvent.

programme.title: Pedro Penduko Episode 2 (The Return of the Comeback)
programme.desc: He is descendant of a Legendary hero, but for the young Pedro Penduko (Janno Gibbs) heroism in the silver screen is more appealing than real life bravado. But Pedro is not destined to be a movie star, he finds himself in the center of a kingdom in need of a hero.

programme.title: Darkroom
programme.desc: A group of teenage friends who seeks the thrill of ghost-hunting, and stumbles upon an old camera. As they carelessly play with it, they unknowingly summon the demon that exists inside.

programme.title: Lupe, A Seaman's Wife
programme.desc: Lupe (Andrea del Rosario) and Manolo (Leandro Muñoz ) are a young couple whose marriage life is about to undergo a drastic change when Manolo leaves for another country.

programme.title: Ikaw Lamang
programme.desc: A charming, light-hearted tale about the ups and downs of growing up, and the joys and pains of young love.

programme.title: Isang Lahi, Isang Dugo Sa Lupang Pangako
programme.desc: \"Lupang Pangako\" or Land of Promise --- that is what people call Mindanao because of its vast untapped natural resources. As such, several people want to claim it for themselves.

programme.title: Buhay Kamao
programme.desc: Pepe, did not want anything to do with boxing but the easy money involved in the sport attracted him when he was desperate to pay off a long standing debt. Little did he know that the match was just the beginning of a series of tests.

programme.title: Hello, Universe!
programme.desc: Ariel (Janno Gibbs), a middle-aged man full of regrets, gets another chance to rewrite his past when he meets a magical figure who gives him the life he has always dreamt of. But at what cost?

programme.title: Bullet
programme.desc: He has the mind and temper of a young child, but when it comes to guns, Bullet (Cesar) is as adept as a highly trained marksman. But this very special talent comes into a harrowing play when Bullet.
Anton and Erika have been a couple for 12 years already. While he's not yet ready to get married, Erika waits until he is and lovingly devotes her time to him.

programme.title: Ang Erpat Kong Astig
programme.desc: At a relatively young age, Joe Cuartero (JinggoyEstrada) is already a widower. With his wife gone, Joe’s life is now centered on his young daughter Tweety (Bea Bueno).

programme.title: Abay Babes
programme.desc: It tells the story of five girls who have been best friends since high school and are reunited for a wedding of the least attractive person in their group.

programme.title: Yorme: The Isko Domagoso Story
programme.desc: Isko Moreno, a once lowly garbage collector who became an actor and now a government servant who dreams for a better life for every Filipino.

programme.title: Reroute
programme.desc: A couple found themselves on a sinister refuge after their car malfunctioned while taking a long-distance route to their hometown.

programme.title: Patayan Files: Ang Pinakamalaking Murder Cases ng Dekada '90
programme.desc: Cheche Lazaro's Probe Archives goes in depth on the controversy behind the gruesome crimes that shocked the entire country during the 90s.

programme.title: Tuloy, Bukas ang Pinto
programme.desc: They are long-lost cousins who grew up in different places and in different ways. When they all finally find themselves gathered at the imposing house of the grandmother, tension builds as they wait for the lawyer who holds their grandmother’s will.

programme.title: Camp Sawi
programme.desc: A group of brokenhearted women end up at a resort that specializes in helping people ease their pain.

programme.title: No Other Woman
programme.desc: The film revolves on a man's journey on becoming a successful working husband whose perfect marriage becomes complicated when he commits into an adulterous affair that changes his life.

programme.title: Petrang Kabayo (2010)
programme.desc: Peter (Vice Ganda) is a boy who is always maltreated by his father because of his homosexuality. He decided to run away and was found by a wealthy lady, Doña Biday, and is adopted by her but becomes abusive of his new found wealth.

programme.title: Boy Golden
programme.desc: The leader of a notorious gang is released from prison. He is on the lookout for the rival gang leader who is responsible for his imprisonment and also the rape and murder of his sister. He plots and executes revenge with the help of his friends.

programme.title: Asin At Paminta
programme.desc: They are the most unlikely of tandems; two men whose only similarity is their gender.

programme.title: Akin Ang Labang Ito
programme.desc: Dario rescues a powerful syndicate head, Don Manolo, from an assassination attempt. Meanwhile, Carlo discovers the Don's business in drugs and he tries to quit.

programme.title: This Time
programme.desc: Coby and Ava only see each other during summer vacations. As time passes, the two develop feelings for each other but having a relationship long-distance is a great challenge for both.

programme.title: Annie B.
programme.desc: Annie (Jolina Magdangal) tells her story and it is true that life is a fairy tale. And she lives her fairy tale day by day.

programme.title: Ikaw Pa Rin Ang Pipiliin Ko
programme.desc: Music gives her life. Music is his life. This is a story that will make our hearts skip a beat this season of love.

programme.title: A.B. Normal College
programme.desc: Brace yourself as the hilarious guys of A.B. Normal College bring chaos and fun to their university! Andres (Andrew E.), Dominic (Ogie Alcasid) and Miguel (Mikey Arroyo), the school's most notorious students, are challenged when the school participates in a quiz show to upgrade the image of the school.

programme.title: Ang Kabit Ni Mrs. Montero
programme.desc: Ang Kabit Ni Mrs. Montero tells the story of a young, beautiful wife (Patricia Javier) who’s wealthy but paraplegic husband (Edu Manzano) cannot provide her the physical intimacy she desires.

programme.title: Saplot
programme.desc: Mystery unfolds when the family of a well-known ramp and commercial model was brutally massacred.

programme.title: Tragic Theater
programme.desc: A team of exorcists are sent into an old theater that is rumored to have been the site of a great tragedy during its construction.

programme.title: Two of Us
programme.desc: The story of two people who find each other while trying to make a living in a foreign country. But as time passes, underneath the sweet moments lie a toxic relationship that sparks violent tendencies.

programme.title: My Bakit List
programme.desc: Bombarded with so much why's in her life, Dess (Louise delos Reyes) embarks on a soul searching journey. Unknown to her, she is about to face the biggest why of her life when she accidentally bumps into her ex-boyfriend who left her without any explanation.

programme.title: Booba
programme.desc: Rufa Mae stars in this comedy as Booba as she endeavors in the metropolis to fulfill her promise to her dying mother that she will find her jealous and insecure sister who run away from home.

programme.title: Tulak ng Bibig, Kabig ng Dibdib
programme.desc: After spending a couple of years behind bars, Lando wins back his freedom. Desperate for a job, he agrees to work for Mariel despite his negative impression of her.

programme.title: More Than Blue
programme.desc: K (JC Santos) and Cream (Yassi Pressman) believe they're soulmates. When K finds out that he's dying, he thinks setting her free would be best for her.

programme.title: Maria
programme.desc: When a former BlackRose cartel assassin deliberately betrays them by refusing to complete her mission, the cartel orders her execution. Unbeknownst to them, she fakes her own death and is able to create a new life of her own.

programme.title: Anong Ganap?
programme.desc: Being in on the entertainment circle is quick and easy on PBO's Anong Ganap? Presented by the gorgeous entertainment anchor ng bayan, Phoemela Baranda.

programme.title: Roadtrip
programme.desc: After their friend’s death, four women set out on the dream trip they planned as teenagers, rekindling old bonds as they pay their last respects.

programme.title: Spellbound
programme.desc: A Filipino adaptation of a South Korean film about Yuri (Bela Padilla), a woman haunted by ghosts after a car accident. Victor (Marco Gumabao), a street magician, turns her experiences into a popular horror-magic performance.

programme.title: Nightshift
programme.desc: A young woman is stuck in the morgue - on her first day - working as an assistant to a pathologist when the dead begin to manifest signs of resurrection.

programme.title: Paligayahin Mo Ako
programme.desc: Susan and Zeny are sisters who have long endured their father's uselessness. Together with their mother, they have struggled to keep their family afloat by raising ducks.

programme.title: Deception
programme.desc: A woman is released from jail ten years after she killed her husband. When she meets a guy that looks exactly as her husband, she starts to connect the dots linked to the night the murder happened.

programme.title: Sugat Sa Puri
programme.desc: He has been a good man all his life. A dutiful son, a loving brother, a considerate friend. But one day, armed thugs barged into his quiet life and murder his family.

programme.title: First Love
programme.desc: In what appears to be a serendipitous encounter upon saving the life of a stranger, the calculated and reserved businessman Nick (Aga Muhlach) meets the impulsive and optimistic photographer Ali (Bea Alonzo), who believes in destiny and carpe diem.
